checks.summary: The exact candidate passed all 169 deterministic tests, including byte- and time-bounded provider input, rejected-body cancellation, observation-bound canonical replay, fail-closed capability and duplicate-ID handling, bounded captured freshness, atomic snapshot-first publication with observation commit evidence, concurrency-correct reuse evidence, refresh-persistence rollback, symlink-safe stores, provenance validation, and stale-input isolation.
